title: Orange, green and a running figure
label: Brand gallery
lede: Kozmo’s look was two flat colors and a logo of a figure in mid-stride. The press remembered the couriers’ orange jackets more than anything on the site. The marks below survive in the archive, alongside our drawings in the same spirit.

archive.caption: The kozmo.com logo, from the header of the closing notice.

archive.credit: Cropped from an Internet Archive capture of kozmo.com. Shown for commentary; the Kozmo.com name and logo belong to their owners.

drawings.caption: One video, one pint, one trip. Revenue per order in late 1999 was $11.92 (derived).[^1]
